environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed with a VPC endpoint policy on the execute-api interface endpoint that enforces request body schema validation at the network layer. Additionally, the Lambda function's ENI is associated with a security group that has outbound rules restricted to port 443 only toward a prefix list (pl-02cd2c6b) for S3 and the internal registry CIDR (10.0.0.0/16). The subnet route table has no route to 169.254.169.254 link-local range due to a custom blackhole route entry (169.254.169.254/32 -> blackhole) added via Terraform aws_route resource. The function also uses a Lambda Extension layer (arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:634166935893:layer:vault-lambda-extension:14) that rotates credentials and the execution role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/DenyIMDSBoundary) that includes an explicit deny on sts:AssumeRole for the Lambda's own role ARN from non-VPC-endpoint sources.

config.lambda_extension: vault-lambda-extension v14 (credential rotation, no static creds in env)
config.permissions_boundary: DenyIMDSBoundary - explicit deny on ec2:DescribeInstances, sts:AssumeRole from non-VPC-endpoint sourceVpce condition

api_gateway.request_validation: body schema enforced via VPC endpoint policy condition
